480	    def get_finalized_receipts(self, payload: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
481	        """POST /v1/transactions/finalized-receipts — a batch of
482	        offline-verifiable finalized receipts sharing one chain snapshot.
483	
484	        The body must be a JSON object containing exactly the ``tx_ids``
485	        key: a non-empty list of distinct 64-lowercase-hex strings (the
486	        same rules as ``POST /v1/blocks/{height}/proofs``). A malformed
487	        body — parse failure, missing/extra keys, a wrong type, an empty
488	        list, duplicates or a wrongly formatted id — is 400 and never
489	        touches state. If every id is well formed but any of them is held
490	        neither on the canonical chain nor in the mempool (candidate forks
491	        are never matches), the answer is 404; otherwise, when nothing is
492	        missing but at least one transaction is still in the mempool or
493	        packed into the unconfirmed pending tip, the answer is 409.
494	
495	        On success the chain and the current audit signer are snapshotted
496	        together under one store lock (exactly as for
497	        :meth:`get_finalized_receipt`), so every item, the shared header
498	        run and the finality credential can never mix chain states. The
499	        body has the fixed key order ``items, headers, finality``:
500	        ``items`` is ordered by ``tx_id`` ascending regardless of the
501	        request order, and each item has the fixed key order
502	        ``receipt, proof`` using the exact single-receipt contract;
503	        ``headers`` is the continuous five-field confirmed header run from
504	        the **lowest** transaction's block up to and including the highest
505	        confirmed block (every item confirmed); ``finality`` is exactly the
506	        ``GET /v1/chain/finality`` document, whose ``finalized`` names the
507	        last header.
508	        """
509	        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or set(payload) != {"tx_ids"}:
510	            return 400, {"error": "request body must be a JSON object with only 'tx_ids'"}
511	        tx_ids_raw = payload["tx_ids"]
512	        if not isinstance(tx_ids_raw, list) or not tx_ids_raw:
513	            return 400, {"error": "field 'tx_ids' must be a non-empty array"}
514	        if any(not crypto.is_hex64(tx_id) for tx_id in tx_ids_raw):
515	            return 400, {
516	                "error": "every tx_id must be a string of 64 lowercase hex characters"
517	            }
518	        if len(set(tx_ids_raw)) != len(tx_ids_raw):
519	            return 400, {"error": "tx_ids must be distinct"}
520	
521	        from . import light_client
522	
523	        with self.store.lock:
524	            requested = sorted(tx_ids_raw)
525	            requested_set = set(requested)
526	            # One pass over the canonical chain (which includes the pending
527	            # tip) locates every request id at its first inclusion point.
528	            located: dict[str, tuple[Block, int, Transaction]] = {}
529	            for block in self.store.chain:
530	                for index, tx in enumerate(block.transactions):
531	                    if tx.tx_id in requested_set and tx.tx_id not in located:
532	                        located[tx.tx_id] = (block, index, tx)
533	            # A 404 takes precedence over a 409: an id absent from both the
534	            # chain and the mempool does not exist, even if another id of
535	            # the same batch is merely unconfirmed.
536	            unknown = [
537	                tx_id
538	                for tx_id in requested
539	                if tx_id not in located
540	                and tx_id not in self.store.pending
541	            ]
542	            if unknown:
543	                return 404, {"error": "transaction not found"}
544	            for tx_id, (_block, _index, tx) in located.items():
545	                if not self._is_receipt_tx_well_typed(tx):
546	                    return 404, {"error": "transaction not found"}
547	            if any(
548	                tx_id in self.store.pending
549	                or located[tx_id][0].status != STATUS_CONFIRMED
550	                for tx_id in requested
551	            ):
552	                # Packed-but-unconfirmed transactions can only sit in the
553	                # pending chain tip; everything else here is in the mempool.
554	                return 409, {"error": "transaction is not confirmed"}
555	
556	            items = []
557	            lowest_height: int | None = None
558	            for tx_id in requested:
559	                block, index, tx = located[tx_id]
560	                if lowest_height is None or block.height < lowest_height:
561	                    lowest_height = block.height
562	                items.append(
563	                    {
564	                        "receipt": self._transaction_receipt(
565	                            tx,
566	                            STATUS_CONFIRMED,
567	                            block.height,
568	                            block.block_hash,
569	                            index,
570	                        ),
571	                        "proof": {
572	                            "height": block.height,
573	                            "tx_id": tx.tx_id,
574	                            "index": index,
575	                            "merkle_root": block.merkle_root,
576	                            "block_hash": block.block_hash,
577	                            "siblings": crypto.merkle_proof(
578	                                [candidate.tx_id for candidate in block.transactions],
579	                                index,
580	                            ),
581	                        },
582	                    }
583	                )
584	
585	            finalized_block = next(
586	                candidate
587	                for candidate in reversed(self.store.chain)
588	                if candidate.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED
589	            )
590	            # The run spans the lowest transaction block through the highest
591	            # confirmed block; every block in between is confirmed because
592	            # the only pending block the chain ever carries is its tip.
593	            assert lowest_height is not None
594	            headers = [
595	                self._header_entry(candidate)
596	                for candidate in self.store.chain[
597	                    lowest_height : finalized_block.height + 1
598	                ]
599	            ]
600	            finalized = self._anchor_descriptor(finalized_block)
601	            tip = self._fork_summary(self.store.chain)
602	            signer = self.store.audit_signer
603	            if signer is None:
604	                # Every snapshot (including migrated legacy ones) carries a
605	                # current audit signer after recovery; reaching here is a
606	                # programming error rather than a client-visible condition.
607	                raise RuntimeError(
608	                    "no audit signer available for finalized receipts"
609	                )
610	            auth = light_client.sign_finality(
611	                signer["private_key"], signer["version"], finalized, tip
612	            )
613	            if auth is None:
614	                raise RuntimeError("current audit signer key is invalid")
615	            return 200, {
616	                "items": items,
617	                "headers": headers,
618	                "finality": {
619	                    "finalized": finalized,
620	                    "tip": tip,
621	                    "auth": auth,
622	                },
623	            }

625	    def audit_receipt_proofs(self, payload: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
626	        """POST /v1/transactions/receipt-proofs/audit — offline audit summary
627	        for a batch of ``receipt_proof`` documents.
628	
629	        The body must be a JSON object containing exactly the keys
630	        ``documents, expected_root`` in that order: ``documents`` a
631	        non-empty array whose items are each audited under the
632	        ``receipt_proof`` contract and ``expected_root`` the caller-pinned
633	        64-lowercase-hex Merkle root. A malformed body — parse failure,
634	        missing/extra/out-of-order keys, an empty array or an illegal root
635	        — is 400 with the ordered body ``{"ok": false, "error": "input"}``
636	        and never touches state.
637	
638	        A legal batch is answered 200 with the core
639	        :func:`ledger.light_client.receipt_proofs_audit` result verbatim
640	        (key order ``ok, root, total, succeeded, errors, entries,
641	        digest``). The audit is a pure function of the request body: no
642	        state is read or written, so concurrent requests and restarts
643	        yield identical results.
644	        """
645	        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or tuple(payload.keys()) != (
646	            "documents",
647	            "expected_root",
648	        ):
649	            return 400, {"ok": False, "error": "input"}
650	        documents = payload["documents"]
651	        expected_root = payload["expected_root"]
652	        if not isinstance(documents, list) or not documents:
653	            return 400, {"ok": False, "error": "input"}
654	        if not crypto.is_hex64(expected_root):
655	            return 400, {"ok": False, "error": "input"}
656	        from . import light_client
657	
658	        return 200, light_client.receipt_proofs_audit(documents, expected_root)

662	    def mine_block(self) -> tuple[int, dict]:
663	        """Pack all pending transactions (ascending tx_id) into a pending block.
664	
665	        Only allowed when the chain tip is confirmed; the new block becomes
666	        the pending tip until it is confirmed or rolled back.
667	        """
668	        with self.store.lock:
669	            if self.store.tip_is_pending():
670	                return 409, {"error": "tip block is pending confirmation"}
671	            if not self.store.pending:
672	                return 409, {"error": "no pending transactions"}
673	            ordered = sorted(self.store.pending.values(), key=lambda tx: tx.tx_id)
674	            block = Block.create(
675	                height=self.store.next_height(),
676	                prev_hash=self.store.tip_hash(),
677	                transactions=ordered,
678	                status=STATUS_PENDING,
679	            )
680	            self.store.chain.append(block)
681	            removed = [self.store.pending.pop(tx.tx_id) for tx in ordered]
682	            try:
683	                self.store.save()
684	            except BaseException:
685	                # Undo the in-memory block so nothing un-persisted is visible.
686	                self.store.chain.pop()
687	                self.store.pending.update({tx.tx_id: tx for tx in removed})
688	                raise
689	        return 201, {
690	            "height": block.height,
691	            "block_hash": block.block_hash,
692	            "merkle_root": block.merkle_root,
693	            "status": block.status,
694	        }

717	    def confirm_block(self, height: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
718	        """Confirm a pending tip block.
719	
720	        Only a pending chain tip whose parent is confirmed can be confirmed.
721	        Confirming an already-confirmed block is idempotent (200); every
722	        other case — unknown or malformed height, non-tip pending block —
723	        returns 409.
724	        """
725	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
726	        with self.store.lock:
727	            if height_int is None:
728	                return 409, {"error": "block cannot be confirmed"}
729	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
730	            if block is None:
731	                return 409, {"error": "block cannot be confirmed"}
732	            if block.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED:
733	                # Idempotent re-confirm.
734	                return 200, {"height": block.height, "status": STATUS_CONFIRMED}
735	            if block is not self.store.tip():
736	                return 409, {"error": "only the chain tip can be confirmed"}
737	            parent = self.store.chain[-2] if len(self.store.chain) >= 2 else None
738	            if parent is None or parent.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
739	                return 409, {"error": "previous block is not confirmed"}
740	            block.status = STATUS_CONFIRMED
741	            try:
742	                self.store.save()
743	            except BaseException:
744	                block.status = STATUS_PENDING
745	                raise
746	            return 200, {"height": block.height, "status": STATUS_CONFIRMED}

748	    def rollback_block(self, height: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
749	        """Roll back a pending tip block: delete it and restore its transactions.
750	
751	        Unknown or malformed heights (including an already-rolled-back
752	        height) return 404; a confirmed block or a non-tip block returns 409.
753	        """
754	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
755	        if height_int is None:
756	            return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
757	        with self.store.lock:
758	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
759	            if block is None:
760	                return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
761	            if block.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED:
762	                return 409, {"error": "confirmed block cannot be rolled back"}
763	            if block is not self.store.tip():
764	                return 409, {"error": "only the chain tip can be rolled back"}
765	            pending_before = set(self.store.pending)
766	            rolled_back = self.store.rollback_tip()
767	            try:
768	                self.store.save()
769	            except BaseException:
770	                # Restore the block and drop only the mempool entries we added.
771	                self.store.chain.append(rolled_back)
772	                for tx_id in list(self.store.pending):
773	                    if tx_id not in pending_before:
774	                        del self.store.pending[tx_id]
775	                raise

778	    def get_proof(self, height: object, tx_id: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
779	        """Return a Merkle inclusion proof for tx_id at the given height.
780

782	        transaction absent from that block. Proofs are only issued for
783	        confirmed blocks; a pending block returns 409.
784	        """
785	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
786	        if height_int is None:
787	            return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
788	        if not crypto.is_hex64(tx_id):
789	            return 404, {"error": "transaction not found"}

791	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
792	            if block is None:
793	                return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
794	            if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
795	                return 409, {"error": "block is pending confirmation"}
796	            tx_ids = [tx.tx_id for tx in block.transactions]
797	            try:
798	                index = tx_ids.index(tx_id)
799	            except ValueError:
800	                return 404, {"error": "transaction not found"}
801	            siblings = crypto.merkle_proof(tx_ids, index)

803	                "height": block.height,
804	                "tx_id": tx_id,

811	    def get_proofs(self, height: object, payload: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
812	        """Return Merkle inclusion proofs for a batch of tx_ids at one height.
813	
814	        POST /v1/blocks/{height}/proofs with ``{"tx_ids": [...]}``. The body

816	        non-empty list of distinct 64-lowercase-hex strings. A malformed body
817	        — parse failure, missing/extra keys, a wrong type, an empty list,
818	        duplicates or a wrongly formatted id — is 400 and never touches state.
819	        A malformed/unknown height or any requested transaction absent from
820	        the block is 404; proofs are only issued for confirmed blocks, so a
821	        pending block returns 409.
822	
823	        On success the body carries the block's complete ascending
824	        ``transaction_ids`` (every leaf) plus one
825	        ``{tx_id, index, siblings}`` proof per requested id, the proofs sorted
826	        by tx_id; the sibling paths run leaf-to-root exactly like
827	        :meth:`get_proof`.
828	        """
829	        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or set(payload) != {"tx_ids"}:
830	            return 400, {"error": "request body must be a JSON object with only 'tx_ids'"}
831	        tx_ids_raw = payload["tx_ids"]
832	        if not isinstance(tx_ids_raw, list) or not tx_ids_raw:
833	            return 400, {"error": "field 'tx_ids' must be a non-empty array"}
834	        if any(not crypto.is_hex64(tx_id) for tx_id in tx_ids_raw):
835	            return 400, {
836	                "error": "every tx_id must be a string of 64 lowercase hex characters"
837	            }
838	        if len(set(tx_ids_raw)) != len(tx_ids_raw):
839	            return 400, {"error": "tx_ids must be distinct"}
840	
841	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
842	        if height_int is None:
843	            return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
844	        with self.store.lock:
845	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
846	            if block is None:
847	                return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
848	            if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
849	                return 409, {"error": "block is pending confirmation"}
850	            tx_ids = [tx.tx_id for tx in block.transactions]
851	            present = set(tx_ids)
852	            if any(tx_id not in present for tx_id in tx_ids_raw):
853	                return 404, {"error": "transaction not found"}
854	            requested = sorted(set(tx_ids_raw))
855	            proofs = []

861	                    "siblings": crypto.merkle_proof(tx_ids, index),
862	                })

864	                "height": block.height,
865	                "block_hash": block.block_hash,
866	                "merkle_root": block.merkle_root,

887	        self, chain: list | None = None
888	    ) -> tuple[list[tuple[str, int, list[str]]], list[str], str]:
889	        """Build the confirmed account rows (ascending account), their leaves
890	        and the Merkle root, all from the confirmed chain under the current
891	        endowment. ``chain`` defaults to the whole canonical chain; a confirmed
892	        prefix replays historical state deterministically. Caller must hold the
893	        store lock.
894	        """

896	            chain = self.store.chain
897	        rows = self.store.account_state_rows(chain, self.initial_balance)
898	        leaves = [

904	    def get_state_root(self, height: object = None) -> tuple[int, dict]:
905	        """GET /v1/state/root and GET /v1/state/root/{height}.
906	
907	        Without a height the tree is anchored to the highest block. A pending
908	        chain tip anchors nothing yet, so the endpoint returns 404 until the
909	        tip is confirmed.
910	
911	        With a path height the state is replayed only from genesis through
912	        that block: the height must be an unsigned decimal without leading
913	        zeros (malformed heights are treated like any unknown path), the block
914	        must exist on the canonical chain and be confirmed — an unknown,
915	        non-canonical or pending height returns 404. The success body has
916	        exactly the same four fields as the unanchored endpoint.
917	        """
918	        with self.store.lock:
919	            if height is None:
920	                anchor = self.store.tip()
921	            else:
922	                # Strict unsigned decimal with no leading zeros, signs or
923	                # whitespace; every malformed value is an unknown path (404).
924	                height_int = _parse_decimal(height)
925	                if height_int is None:
926	                    return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
927	                anchor = self.store.block_at(height_int)
928	                if anchor is None:
929	                    return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
930	            if anchor.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
931	                return 404, {"error": "chain tip is pending confirmation"}
932	            prefix = self.store.chain if height is None else self.store.chain[: anchor.height + 1]
933	            rows, _leaves, root = self._state_tree(prefix)
934	            return 200, {
935	                "state_root": root,
936	                "height": anchor.height,
937	                "block_hash": anchor.block_hash,
938	                "account_count": len(rows),
939	            }

1201	    def reported_balance(self, account: str) -> int:
1202	        """Confirmed balance minus spends sitting in the pending tip block.
1203	
1204	        Pending-block credits are not counted: unconfirmed income can still
1205	        be rolled back, so it must not inflate the reported balance.
1206	        """
1207	        balance = self.confirmed_balance(account)
1208	        tip = self.store.tip()
1209	        if tip.status == STATUS_PENDING:
1210	            for tx in tip.transactions:
1211	                if tx.sender == account:
1212	                    balance -= tx.amount
1213	        return balance

1215	    def available_balance(self, account: str) -> int:
1216	        """Reported balance minus amounts already committed in the mempool.
1217	
1218	        Pending credits (mempool or unconfirmed block) are deliberately not
1219	        counted, so a sequence of submissions cannot spend money that has not
1220	        been confirmed yet.
1221	        """
1222	        balance = self.reported_balance(account)
1223	        for tx in self.store.pending.values():
1224	            if tx.sender == account:
1225	                balance -= tx.amount
1226	        return balance

1230	    @staticmethod
1231	    def _fork_summary(blocks: list) -> dict:
1232	        """Public fork descriptor S: tip_hash, height, length, status."""
1233	        tip = blocks[-1]
1234	        return {
1235	            "tip_hash": tip.block_hash,
1236	            "height": tip.height,
1237	            # The length counts every block including the genesis block.
1238	            "length": len(blocks),

1242	    def _winning_fork(self) -> tuple[str, list]:
1243	        """Pick the winner among the canonical chain and every candidate.
1244	
1245	        Longest chain wins; equal lengths are broken by the smallest tip hash
1246	        (lexicographic hex order). Returns (tip_hash, block list).
1247	        """
1248	        contenders: list[tuple[str, list]] = [
1249	            (self.store.tip_hash(), self.store.chain)
1250	        ]
1251	        contenders.extend(self.store.forks.items())
1252	        contenders.sort(key=lambda item: (-len(item[1]), item[0]))
1253	        return contenders[0]

1255	    def submit_fork_candidate(self, payload: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
1256	        """POST /v1/forks/candidates — validate and store a candidate fork.
1257	
1258	        Returns 201 with the fork descriptor S. Malformed or invalid forks
1259	        return 400; a fork already known (identical to the canonical tip or an
1260	        existing candidate tip) returns 409.
1261	        """
1262	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
1263	            return 400, {"error": "request body must be a JSON object"}
1264	        blocks_raw = payload.get("blocks")
1265	        if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list):
1266	            return 400, {"error": "missing field: blocks (must be a list)"}
1267	        try:
1268	            fork = self.store.validate_fork_blocks(blocks_raw)
1269	        except ValueError as exc:
1270	            return 400, {"error": str(exc)}
1271	        summary = self._fork_summary(fork)
1272	        # An exported fork (the five-field {tip_hash, height, length, status,
1273	        # blocks} document) may be resubmitted verbatim; every supplied summary
1274	        # field is re-verified against the recomputed descriptor.
1275	        for field in ("tip_hash", "height", "length", "status"):
1276	            if field in payload and payload[field] != summary[field]:
1277	                return 400, {"error": f"summary field {field!r} does not match the blocks"}
1278	        tip_hash = fork[-1].block_hash
1279	        with self.store.lock:
1280	            self._prune_expired_syncs()
